Lactation counseling, built around how you actually feed

Whether you're breastfeeding, pumping, combo-feeding, or still deciding — you get judgment-free, evidence-based support from a Certified Lactation Counselor (CLC), not a script.

Book a free intro call

What we work on together

Every session starts with your actual situation — your feeding goals, your baby's latch, your body — not a one-size-fits-all checklist.

01

Latch & positioning support

A hands-on (or video) assessment of how your baby is latching, why it might be uncomfortable or ineffective, and specific adjustments to try — for newborns just starting out or for latches that have never quite felt right.

02

Low supply & oversupply concerns

A real assessment of your supply — feeding frequency, transfer, weight gain — rather than a guess based on how full you feel. If supply is genuinely low or high, we build a plan around it; if it isn't, you get to stop worrying about it.

03

Pumping & return-to-work planning

Building a pumping routine that protects your supply and fits your actual schedule — including bottle introduction, paced feeding for caregivers, and a timeline for going back to work.

04

Prenatal feeding consults

Before baby arrives — what to expect in the first days, how to set yourself up for the feeding relationship you want, and what "normal" newborn feeding actually looks like so you're not blindsided.

05

Weaning & combo-feeding guidance

Whether you're introducing formula, weaning on your own timeline, or navigating a mix of breast, bottle, and formula — a plan that keeps your baby fed and your supply comfortable through the transition.

How a session works

What to expect

Before we meet

You'll fill out a short intake covering feeding history, your baby's age and weight trend, and what's feeling hardest right now.

During the session

A real assessment — not generic advice — with time to actually try adjustments together, whether that's a latch, a pump flange size, or a schedule.

After the session

A written summary of what we covered and what to try next, plus a window for follow-up questions as you put it into practice.

If something's medical

If I see something outside a CLC's scope — tongue tie, a medical feeding issue — I'll tell you directly and help you find the right referral.

A framework, not a checklist

The Breastfeeding Support Circle

Feeding looks different for every family. This is the shape I use to talk through where you are right now — and it's okay to move between circles as your needs and your baby's needs change.

Common questions

Is this only for newborns?

No — I work with feeding relationships at every stage, from prenatal planning through weaning a toddler.

What if I'm not breastfeeding?

Feeding support isn't only for breastfeeding families. Combo-feeding, exclusive pumping, and formula-feeding all come with their own questions, and all of them are welcome here.

Do you do virtual sessions?

Yes — many latch and supply concerns can be assessed well over video, though I'll always tell you if something really needs to be seen in person.

Ready to stop guessing about feeding?
